title: Maximum Unit Cubes Cut by a Plane in [0, n]^3 (Cheese-Cutting Theorem M)
description: Unconditional Lean 4 + Mathlib formalization over R of the exact maximum number m(n) of open unit cubes of the n x n x n cube [0, n]^3 met by a single plane, proving m(n) = floor((9n^2 + 4n - 17)/4) for all 3 <= n <= 32 (in particular m(10) = 230, settling the open case stated by Barany and Frankl, 2021) and for all n >= 700, refuting Barany and Frankl's Section 5 "+2" remark for all n >= 700, and proving the universal upper bound m(n) <= floor((9n^2 + 6n - 20)/4) for every n >= 2. The finite intermediate window 33 <= n <= 699 is not discharged inside Lean and is certified separately by exact-integer programs documented in the accompanying paper.
